record_kind.name: Role
record_kind.definition: Formal organisational role, separate from people and login permissions.

record_kind.name: Source
record_kind.definition: Link to an immutable job-description document version for a formal role.

record_kind.name: Source statement
record_kind.definition: Exact located wording in a source document.

record_kind.name: Ontology term
record_kind.definition: Governed provisional classification or relationship vocabulary.

record_kind.name: Atomic responsibility
record_kind.definition: Normalised responsibility pinned to exact source wording.

record_kind.name: Connection
record_kind.definition: Governed relationship between responsibilities; directionality is inherited from its relationship term.

record_kind.name: Person in role
record_kind.definition: Link from a formal role to a canonical staff identity.

lifecycle.name: Superseded
lifecycle.definition: Replaced or retired; original evidence remains unchanged.

review.name: Draft
review.definition: Analytical record awaiting human review, independent of evidence status.

review.name: Reviewed
review.definition: Human review confirmed; does not imply documentary evidence.

evidence.name: Documentary / explicit
evidence.definition: Connection explicitly supported by a pinned source statement.

evidence.name: Inferred
evidence.definition: Interpretation rather than an explicit documentary connection.

evidence.name: Approved operational
evidence.definition: Operationally approved relationship; not necessarily stated in a JD.

role_mapping.name: Referenced
role_mapping.definition: Role referenced without a complete responsibility mapping.

ontology_category.name: Domain / subdomain
ontology_category.definition: Topic classification; a domain parent_id represents subdomain hierarchy.

ontology_category.name: Responsibility / action type
ontology_category.definition: Classification of the kind of responsibility or action.

ontology_category.name: Responsibility level
ontology_category.definition: Optional governed organisational or responsibility level.

ontology_category.name: Relationship type
ontology_category.definition: Meaning and optional directional semantics of a connection between responsibilities.

source_type.name: Job description
source_type.definition: Versioned source job description in shared Documents.

directionality.name: Directed
directionality.definition: Stored endpoint order determines traversal direction; default for existing terms.

directionality.name: Symmetric
directionality.definition: Traversable from either endpoint; no arrow or process-order inference.

grouping.name: Source statement
grouping.definition: Shared pinned documentary statement identifies the companion group, not chain distance.

direction.name: From → to
direction.definition: Ordered storage endpoints; semantic directionality is inherited from the governed relationship term.

levels.description: Optional governed term reference; legacy text and null/unknown remain supported.
